title: RC Parallel & Principle Conform Question Strategy

notes.html:
RC Parallel Question Examples

  • Which one of the following describes a relationship that is most analogous to the one that holds between the fMRI and hypnosis, as described in the passage?

  • The narrative structure of which one of the following hypothetical novels is most closely parallel to that of the films of the 1920s, as that genre is described by the author of the passage?

Principle Conform Question Examples

  • Which one of the following is a principle applied to historical fiction in passage A that the author of passage B would be most likely to regard as not applicable to the genre of autobiography as well?

  • The views put forward in the passage conform most closely to which one of the following principles governing old methods of production?

  • Which one of the following is an application of a principle underlying passage B to the view of narrative fiction ascribed to Sartre in passage A?
